## 🎯 ICP 1: Boutique & Independent Recruitment Agencies
* **Company Size:** 1–5 Recruiters / Headhunters
* **Decision Maker:** Founder / Managing Partner / Principal Recruiter
* **Core Pain Point:** Paying \$60–\$90/recruiter/month for legacy ATS tools (Zoho/Bullhorn) that lack modern AI copilot tools; spending 4+ hours daily manually reading resumes.
* **Buying Trigger:** Need to double candidate throughput without hiring additional junior recruiters.
* **Recommended Plan:** **Starter (\$79/mo or \$790/yr)** or **Growth (\$199/mo or \$1,990/yr)**
* **Primary Pitch:** *"Double your placement speed with real-time AI resume matching and dynamic interview prep for less than the cost of a single Zoho seat."*
